parsed.why: State repealed gender-identity civil-rights protection and imposes birth-certificate facility rule binding visitors on school grounds; listed in worst tier. Adds a hostile layer atop the restrictive national document regime.

Executive order applies birth-sex to all state-facility bathrooms/changing rooms — universal visitor exposure; school bans, closed markers, no state protections, adult care barred in public facilities. Most restrictive layer atop the national regime.

Second-highest risk tier; facility law covers all schools/colleges but has no enforcement mechanism and no documented arrests. Municipal ordinances and employment order partially offset; national document/entry regime unchanged.

Most-protective tier: shield law, full gender-identity nondiscrimination, hate-crime coverage, panic-defense ban, no facility ban — documented protections operating. National passport/entry regime still applies, capping the score.

Most-protective tier with shield laws and insurance coverage, but documented birth-sex prison placement as discipline and two pending anti-trans ballot initiatives create unresolved exposure atop the national regime.
